# Igor Ganapolsky Public Offers

This site contains buyer-facing offers and public product pages from Igor Ganapolsky.

## Primary Offer: ApplyOps AI Staffing 3-Candidate Audit

ApplyOps is a paid candidate proof audit for AI staffing, technical recruiting, executive-search, career-services, and senior technical resume workflows. The primary commercial offer is a $500 three-candidate audit for senior AI, cloud, data, or software profiles before staffing teams submit them to clients.

- Landing page: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/
- Partner / acquisition brief: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/partners.html
- AI staffing candidate audit: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/ai-staffing.html
- STR Claude Ops diagnostic for vacation-rental operators: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/str-claude-ops.html
- AI staffing 3-candidate sample output: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/ai-staffing-sample.html
- Rejection teardown and candidate-packet mismatch example: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/rejection-teardown.html
- Partner pilot sample output: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/partner-sample.html
- Sample audit: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/sample-truth-snapshot.html
- Senior engineer resume audit guide: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/topics/senior-engineer-resume-truth-audit.html
- AI resume and ATS risk audit guide: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/topics/ai-resume-ats-risk-audit.html

### What ApplyOps Does

- Flags unsupported or inflated AI, cloud, platform, leadership, and impact claims.
- Checks ATS readability, target-title fit, and role positioning.
- Identifies candidate proof gaps that create recruiter, hiring-manager, or client doubt.
- Catches target-role mismatch before a staffing team submits a broad senior technical profile into a narrow search.
- Returns a send, rewrite, verify, or hold recommendation without fabricating credentials, employers, dates, degrees, titles, or metrics.

### Paid Offers

- ApplyOps AI Staffing 3-Candidate Audit Deposit: $500 one-time audit for three senior AI, cloud, data, or software candidate profiles before client submission.
- ApplyOps Partner Paid Pilot: $1,500 one-time 10-candidate resume-risk audit batch for resume-writing, staffing, career-coaching, or executive-search partners.
- Resume Truth Snapshot: $49 one-time audit.
- Resume OS Pro: $149 one-time 30-day resume and application workspace.
- Done-For-You Sprint: $1,500 two-week managed job-search operations sprint.
- ApplyOps Partner Pilot Deposit: $500 one-time deposit credited toward the partner paid pilot.
- STR Claude Ops Diagnostic: $500 fixed-scope audit for short-term rental guest messaging, maintenance triage, escalation rules, and Claude guardrails.
- STR Claude Ops Pilot Sprint: $1,500 implementation slice for one Guesty-style data path, human approval workflow, logging, and guardrail test cases.

### Partner And Reverse-Recruiting Use Cases

ApplyOps can be used by reverse-recruiting, apply-for-you, resume-writing, staffing, executive-search, and career-platform teams as an intake checkpoint before candidate outreach or resume rewriting.

- Partner pilot page: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/partners.html
- AI staffing audit page: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/ai-staffing.html
- AI staffing sample output: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/ai-staffing-sample.html
- Reverse-recruiting pilot deposit: $500, credited toward the $1,500 partner pilot.
- Partner pilot output: up to 10 senior technical candidate resume-risk audits, an anonymized findings memo, and a 30-minute readout.
- Best-fit buyers: teams that already help technical candidates with resume rewrites, job-search operations, reverse recruiting, application management, or candidate submission.
- Invoice path: buyers who cannot use card checkout can request a Stripe invoice or scoping call from the partner page.

## Public Brand Page

- Ralph Resume OS: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/ralph-resume-os/

Ralph Resume OS is the private workflow layer behind ApplyOps. Public pages intentionally avoid publishing private application data, implementation details, source artifacts, secrets, or operational runbooks.

## Timed Consulting Offer: Loom to Atlassian Admin + Rovo Readiness

For teams receiving Loom-to-Atlassian integration notices, this offer helps review user roles, billing exposure, Atlassian Administration readiness, Loom/Jira/Confluence workflows, Rovo opportunities, and AI/security guardrails.

- Landing page: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/loom-atlassian/
- Diagnostic: $499 one-time readiness review.
- Implementation sprint: $1,500 one-time migration-readiness sprint.

## Safety And Integrity

ApplyOps does not guarantee employment, fabricate credentials, invent metrics, or submit applications when required facts are unknown.
